plugins.name: Blindspot Ambient Lights
plugins.author: xpilot
plugins.description: Turns the cabin ambient lights red while a car is in the blind spot.

plugins.name: Auto Speed Limit
plugins.author: xpilot
plugins.description: Sets cruise speed to the car's speed limit plus an offset. Needs openpilot longitudinal and the vehicle bus.

plugins.name: Blind Spot Edges
plugins.author: xpilot
plugins.description: Big screen: red edge on the left or right column while a car is in that blind spot. Display only; on by default.

plugins.name: Battery (BMS)
plugins.author: xpilot
plugins.description: Big-screen tile: battery charge, pack voltage, current and power from the BMS messages on the vehicle bus. Needs the vehicle-bus harness. Read only.

plugins.name: Car Tile
plugins.author: xpilot
plugins.description: Big-screen tile: cluster speed, gear, blinkers and blind spots. Display only; on by default.

plugins.name: Clock Tile
plugins.author: xpilot
plugins.description: Big-screen tile: local time and date. Display only; on by default.

plugins.name: Cruise Settings
plugins.author: Sniper-Eon
plugins.description: Cruise switches in one plugin: intelligent cruise buttons, smart cruise from vision and map, main-cruise permission and the initial set speed. Writes the host params only while parked.

plugins.name: External Compute
plugins.author: xpilot
plugins.description: Lets a laptop, LLM server or accelerator exchange data with the device over a cable or WiFi (TCP JSON lines). Peers need the token in /data/params/d/XpilotExternalToken.

plugins.name: IP Tile
plugins.author: xpilot
plugins.description: Big-screen tile: the device IP address and network type. Display only; on by default.

plugins.name: Lead Card
plugins.author: xpilot
plugins.description: Big-screen card: distance and relative speed of the lead car (radarState). Display only; on by default.

plugins.name: MADS Settings
plugins.author: Sniper-Eon
plugins.description: One place for MADS switches: MADS on/off, lateral steering on brake, unified engagement, and the Tesla screen-button mode. Writes the host MADS params only while parked.

plugins.name: Map Tile
plugins.author: xpilot
plugins.description: Big-screen tile: speed limit, road name and next maneuver from any map or navigation provider. Display only; on by default.

plugins.name: Navigation Assist (phone)
plugins.author: Sniper-Eon
plugins.description: Exclusive TesNav v3 or CPdazi v2 navigation source; shared bounded route-lane preparation, native Tesla/BSM veto and maneuver speed ceiling. No passing or stereo features.

plugins.name: openpilot Model
plugins.author: xpilot
plugins.description: Drive with the model that ships with openpilot (selfdrive/modeld, no downloads). Replaces the SP model manager while on; switch it off to go back.

plugins.name: Overspeed Warning
plugins.author: xpilot
plugins.description: Example plugin: warns when driving faster than the resolved speed limit plus a margin. Shows the manifest, store-backed params, a settings row, an alert hook and a relative import.

plugins.name: Phone side-vehicle vision
plugins.author: Sniper-Eon
plugins.description: Optional original single wide-camera vehicle detection transport,640pixels,max4Hz; no camera while disabled.

plugins.name: Speed Card
plugins.author: xpilot
plugins.description: Big-screen card: ego speed and the set speed. Display only; on by default.

plugins.name: Speed Limit Card
plugins.author: xpilot
plugins.description: Big-screen card: the speed limit sunnypilot resolved (longitudinalPlanSP). Display only; on by default.

plugins.name: Tesla Mixed Control
plugins.author: xpilot; dzid26; Haibin Wen and sunnypilot contributors
plugins.description: Angle-based cooperative steering: light driver torque adjusts the SP steering target with speed-dependent effort. SP must own steering; stock Autosteer must not steer at the same time (AP ownership/handoff is not implemented). Enable while parked, then restart. Overrides native TeslaCoopSteering mode for this session without changing its saved setting. Host-tested only; vehicle validation is pending.

plugins.name: TesNav Navigation
plugins.author: juyun86
plugins.description: TesNav phone guidance and recommended-lane display, with optional turn slowdown. No automatic lane changes or steering. Controlled private LAN only.

plugins.name: TN Longitudinal (TN-NoDEC)
plugins.author: xpilot
plugins.description: Replaces SP's longitudinal plan, including lead following, with the TN-NoDEC planner (legacy cruise-obstacle MPC and TN acceleration controller). Prebuilt acados solvers: installs only on the platform it was built for. TN's stopping policy in controlsd is not included.

plugins.name: Traffic Light Control (Experimental)
plugins.author: xpilot
plugins.description: Stops for red lights seen by the car's own traffic-control perception. Only ever slows down.

plugins.name: Turn & Lane Settings
plugins.author: Sniper-Eon
plugins.description: Parked settings for existing turn intent and lane-change delay. The master shows the summary tile; saved driving settings are independent.

plugins.name: Simplified Chinese UI
plugins.author: Sniper-Eon
plugins.description: Chinese option names, values, descriptions and plugin pages. Display only; preserves settings and control behavior.
